get.description:
List jobs for the authenticated worker. Use the ?status filter to scope results:

- **applied** — jobs the worker has applied to (pending/rejected application)
- **invited** — jobs the worker has been invited to (pending invitation)
- **active** — jobs where application or invitation is accepted
- **completed** — jobs marked completed
- **browse** — jobs posted that the worker has no connection with yet

When no status is provided, all connected jobs are returned. Each job includes a worker_status field (applied/invited/active/completed/browse).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: applied, invited, active, completed, browse
